notes.title: New Event & Weekly Jobs - Multiplayer update
notes.notes:
This update brings new multiplayer jobs and weekly challenges.

What is your favorite thing to do during each race? Shoot down drones, planes, show off your flying skills or just win? Everything you do during each race counts and if you complete weekly jobs you will get rewarded.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6536680/25c485d965fc68b2613c993490e3b328b6ed7c90.png[/img]
[b]New week starts on Thursday UTC (Universal Time) and there will be different jobs to complete every week[/b]:
[list]
[*] shoot down planes
[*] shoot drones
[*] fly long distance
[*] collect power up items
[*] complete aerobatics
[*] fly no-crash races
[*] and more...
[/list]

And an awesome sticker is waiting to be collected if you join Friday event because [b]Wing Breakers is Top Fun[/b] - and some movie is out 😜
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6536680/9120eb895c9fee154da48cf0ad307925ff7108b5.png[/img]


Enjoy flying with Wing Breakers!
Cheers,
The Gugila team
✈️❤️

notes.title: Wing Breakers Full Release Coming March 10th, Supporting 10 Languages Now!
notes.notes:
Hello guys,

We are super excited to tell you that [b]Wing Breakers full release is coming on March 10th[/b], finally leaving Early Access!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/V5iz70J.gif[/img]

If you are new to Wing Breakers, don’t forget to [u][b]add the game to your wishlist[/b][/u], so you won’t miss the release date.

Thanks goes to all players who were helping us with bug reports and new features.
Throughout recent beta testing, Wing Breakers has been polished and some final goodies are still on the way.

The big feature in this update is language support - [b]Wing Breakers supports 10 languages now![/b]

We cannot wait to see you guys playing Wing Breakers all around the globe.
And if English is not your strong point, we hope that this update can help you progress through the game easier.

The following languages are now supported:
[list]
[*]English
[*]Simplified Chinese
[*]French
[*]German
[*]Italian
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Brazilian Portuguese
[*]Russian
[*]Spanish
[/list]

If you find some translation mistakes, please let us know. You can use ingame 'Bugs & Ideas' message box or visit Wing Breakers on Discord. https://discord.gg/7HQGAa5Scq

Your feedback and suggestions are greatly appreciated as always!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6536680/2d7948622499086221856790793c8a6c853e3ce4.jpg[/img]

Cheers,
The Gugila team

notes.title: Mouse Patch - 27 Dec
notes.notes:
Quick fix, mouse sensitivity was improved - playing with mouse should be more responsive.
Mouse sensitivity was reset to defaults, you may want to customize the sensitivity settings in the options menu.

notes.title: Move the Mountains - Track Editor Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/i6FxtPF.gif[/img]

Track editor just became godly! Now, nature can now be carved and modified the way you desire. 
Place [b]huge mountains, carve valleys and cracks[/b] to fly through, easily with a few mouse clicks.
Also [b]big bridges[/b] were added to the editor - fun obstacles to race around.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6536680/4b502e6c8a72af82c48162e25cf9839caeba60b1.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6536680/c168d81b974a6015be76bf8b178a3499d07f986b.jpg[/img]

This weekend we will be running the second [b]Weekend Special Speedrun[/b]. 
3 tracks, 9 times to beat and only 15 minutes to do it! 
Not for beginners, players with 'A0 Achiever' license or higher can join.
Beat the time and get a new reward sticker. 
Once this special Speedrun expires, weekly Speedrun will be back until next Thursday. 

And join multiplayer live events every Friday.
2 time slots: 20h CET (Europe) and 20h EST (Americas).

notes.title: Music Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6536680/421faccedeea2722990489e9a9e2f2387a7c2b44.jpg[/img]

This update brings a couple of [b]new songs[/b] and music player clean-up. Now you can listen to a song from beginning to end without interruption. Wherever you are in the game, music will continuously play from one song to the next. 
If you'd like to [b]skip a song[/b], you can simply press rudder-right (key D). To restart a current song, press rudder-left (key A). 
During a race music controls are disabled, so you need to pick your song before the race starts.

In the future expect new songs that cover all different music styles and hopefully fit different tastes.

[b]Other fixes and improvements[/b]:
[list]
[*] Terrain drawing especially high in Alps had problems. Some objects were sinking or floating on those tracks. Problem gone.
[*] Flying upside down had misplaced gravity center position - fixed.
[*] Creating tracks in editor with shortruns would crash the game - fixed.
[*] After race, showcase of winners could show some planes transparent - fixed.
[*] Two license tracks received some new objects - spot them if you can.
[/list]

And join multiplayer live events every Friday.
2 time slots: 20h CET (Europe) and 20h EST (Americas).

notes.title: Showing Off Your Ride Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Hgy3UcB.gif[/img]

Highlights in this update include new [b]replay cameras[/b] in multiplayer and [b]slow-mo end sequence[/b].

New features and improvements:
[list]
[*][b]Replay cameras[/b] were improved: now you can watch your team members while waiting for the race to end. Use backview button (key 'C') to see who's chasing the player.
[*][b]Finish camera[/b] was improved: new slow-mo finish camera allows you to see who's coming in just behind you. 
[*][b]Borderless window[/b] was added, you can find it under graphics settings.
[*]Respawning improved: obstacles are better detected and avoided when plane is repositioned. 
[*]MP Teamplay - player's icon now shows team color, easier to recognize team members.
[*]In solo license mode, some tasks are better explained: close-calls, throttle at max, Moccies.
[*]Fixed: when quitting during slow motion and going to the menu page, game would slow down to a halt.
[/list]

Don't forget to join multiplayer live events on Fridays.
2 time slots: 20h CET (Europe) and 20h EST (Americas).

notes.title: Maintenance MP update
notes.notes:
After our last [b]MP Live event[/b] there were some issue that showed up and needed immediate attention.
Here's the list of recent fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed memory leak & crashing when playing MP for extended time.
[*]Multiplayer plane collisions are now more forgiving and fair. You can [b]push others[/b] now!
[*]Repositoning is now penalized more - 15% damage. Don't reposition too often.
[*]Stickers and decals on other planes looked blurry - fixed.
[*]Respawning after plane crashing avoids getting plane stuck.
[/list] 

And join us for the upcoming MP live event this Friday as usual!
Every Friday 2 time slots, 20h CET (Europe) and 20h EST (Americas).

notes.title: Update: MP Team Play In Action!
notes.notes:
New multiplayer (MP) brings a major new feature, [u][b]Team Play[/b][/u] mode.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/FOVnTsO.gif[/img]

Got skills? That's great, but even if you're not there yet, don't worry. 
In Team Play mode, every player will contribute to the team score. 
Do your best and work together for your team's success!


Another new MP feature is player [u][b]organized events[/b][/u].
Now you can be an event organizer: 
[list]
[*]Set up tracks and race rules, Team Play or Grand Prix. Try them out.
[*][u][b]Give gift items[/b][/u] to players who play you events. Everybody is allowed to contribute gifts and they will be given out randomly to players after the event.
[*][u][b]Write your own message[/b][/u] on event ad board. You can say whatever you wish but please keep it clean.
[*]Events can be private or public.
[/list]

Other fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*][u][b]Item drops[/b][/u] are now given based on [u][b]play time[/b][/u] - play longer tracks for faster drops.
[*][u][b]Replays of top 10 players[/b][/u] for each track can be downloaded on rankings page for practicing or watching. 
[*][u][b]Track editor[/b][/u]: now you can playtest your track and publish it [u][b]in game[/b][/u] directly.
[*]All license tracks had makeovers: more obstacles for more fun, especially in MP.
[*]Game physics were optimized: game runs faster with a lot more dynamic objects.
[*][u][b]Ingame browser[/b][/u] is implemented in MP lobby: get the latest news or event announcements immediately. It makes it also easier to report bugs and give feedback.
[*]Controller options on tutorial more clearly displayed.
[*]Simplified ingame user interface
[*]MP points were added to statistics.
[*]Bug fix: when a player is DSQ in the last race of MP event, plane doesn't show up in showcase.
[*]Bug fix: artificial horizon had problems with plane tilt.
[*]Bug fix: in watch mode, Mocci items collected by other players are shown. 
[*]Bug fix: [u][b]MD graphics card[/b][/u] was not working with DirectX11. Some versions of drivers had problems, AMD fixed it in the latest drivers, workaround will be kept just in case.
[*]Bug fix: chat got stuck on some occasions. 
[/list]

*One more thing: 
During these holidays, visit multiplayer mode for time limited events. 
New exclusive gift items will be given out if you join the official MP team play during certain times.
Event rules will be explained in MP lobby before each event is ready to go on air.  

Let the race begin!

notes.title: Update: New Multiplayer Is Now Live!
notes.notes:
It's finally time to start real racing competitions with a new multiplayer. [b]Multiplayer rounds (MR)[/b] are at core of the new game mode and you can join the action after each race.

Multiplayer also brings players into the same world so [b]collisions & crashing matter[/b]. 
Collect floating items Moccies first or they are gone and avoid hitting others. 
Players can vote on the track to be played next. List of tracks includes official license tracks and many user tracks as well.

Some exclusive ingame drops are waiting for players who join the multiplayer.
[b]So join the live competitions![/b]

[img]http://www.altitude0.com/shared/images/a0_news_newmultiplayer.jpg[/img]

Other fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*]ingame position is now updated immediately during the race.
[*]ingame icons get bigger as planes get closer.
[*]times are displayed with millisecond precision (3 digits), just to be fair.
[*]championship points were adjusted to improve racing experience.
[*]multiplayer got new chat (default is keyboard button 'T').
[*]multiplayer round rankings added.
[*]multiplayer watch mode.
[*]buttons to see rankings added to track picking and championship page.
[*]garage statistics updated.
[*]saved replays now also save correct weather conditions.
[*]bug fix: user track replay by creator not included in rankings.
[*]bug fix: track editor in non-Steam version had starting problems.
[/list]

notes.title: Update: New Rankings & Stats Heaven
notes.notes:
The main feature coming with this update is [b]new improved rankings system[/b]. 
You can compare your stats with [b]friends[/b] and best A0 pilots: compare racing points, medals, aerobatic pts, close calls, items collected and more.

[img]http://www.altitude0.com/shared/images/a0_news_newrankings.jpg[/img]

Championships also got their own rankings and stats. These rankings show players that finished the whole [b]championship in the shortest time[/b] possible. 
There are some surprising names in the top 10 for each championship, check it out.

And some new drops were added.

Other fixes:
[list]
[*]after race showcase: plane effects like vapor & boost fixed, plane showcase layout adjusted to prevent planes from overlapping
[*]Freeway multiplayer:
    - when realtime human opponents join the race, it shows their correct planes including damage and fire.
    - bots (recorded replays of other pilots) are spawned more competitively when you join Freeway.
    - same weather for all players who join the race. 
[*]saving replay also saves weather conditions
[*]replays of your friends are marked.
[*]fixed bug with blue vapor coming constantly from other planes
[/list]

notes.title: Update: Winners' After Race Showcase
notes.notes:
If you win a race, you deserve to be recognized better. 
After each race, top 3 planes are shown closeup - all pimped up or fully damaged looking like a mess. It really depends on the player's racing style.

[img]http://www.altitude0.com/shared/images/a0_news_showcase.jpg[/img]

Other fixes:
[list]
[*]when game cannot connect online, it doesn't save data locally. Now it's clear whether you progress or not. 
[*]championship now exits to the championship page and not the main menu.
[*]fixed: control settings bug - throttle slider key was causing problems when trying to remap it.
[*]advanced control settings now allow manual rudder to have adjusted sensitivity. This is especially useful for players with twist rudder joysticks. 
[*]some new drops added.
[/list]

notes.title: Major update: 7 new pro tracks, achievements, licenses, championships and more
notes.notes:
Hi guys, this update is a major one!
[b]New tracks, 7 of them [/b]- longer & harder for players who got deeper into the game. 
These tracks will take more time to master for sure. Tracks also come with new obstacles: [b]wrecking balls, fiery rings, rotating fans[/b].

[img]http://www.altitude0.com/shared/images/a0_news_majorupdate.jpg[/img]

More licenses with [b]23 new achievements[/b].
New game modes and rules: checkpoint race, laps, mini-challenges and aerobatic points required to complete a race. 
New longer championships to test your stamina & skills.

Misc:
- music doesn't restart anymore after each race
- fixed key remapping (keyboard & gamepad problems)
- new year started and some new drops were added

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update: New plane & items in Steam inventory
notes.notes:
This update comes with a [b]new plane, 'Weight Blazer'[/b]. Game's first biplane, heavier but more sturdy. Fly with the new plane and find out what it can do best.

[img]http://www.altitude0.com/shared/images/a0_news_weightblazer.jpg[/img] 

For some time now, drops like plane skins and stickers are given weekly when you play Altitude0: Lower & Faster. 
Now these drops are shown in [b]Steam inventory[/b]. Some are common and others are rare or available only during some events. 

Other fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*]plane specs were adjusted so planes are balanced better. 
[*]some tracks were modified, part of finalizing current tracks before new license tracks come in. Most modifications were visual. Only 'Alpine Drag' track has a new ranking list. 
[*]in-plane view can be set as default until you exit the game, in-plane camera was also tuned.
[*]fixed: plane specs display in garage fixed.
[*]fixed: when shadows are on, plane edges were extra jaggy.
[*]fixed: when item is traded away, it doesn't show on the plane anymore.
[*]fixed: some achievements were rearranged and tuned.
[/list]

Now these drops are shown in [b]Steam inventory[/b]. Some are common and others are rare or available only during some events. 

Other fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*]plane specs were adjusted so planes are balanced better. 
[*]some tracks were modified, part of finalizing current tracks before new license tracks come in. Most modifications were visual. Only 'Alpine Drag' track has a new ranking list. 
[*]in-plane view can be set as default until you exit the game, in-plane camera was also tuned.
[*]fixed: plane specs display in garage fixed.
[*]fixed: when shadows are on, plane edges were extra jaggy.
[*]fixed: when item is traded away, it doesn't show on the plane anymore.
[*]fixed: some achievements were rearranged and tuned.
[/list]

notes.title: Update: Sticker Placement tool & Gift Presentation
notes.notes:
The latest update brings new airplane sticker placement tool. In garage, you can see spots on each plane available for sticker placement and camera will zoom in and show the exact location up close. Find best spots for your stickers and pimp your plane! 

[img]http://www.altitude0.com/shared/images/a0_news_stickers.jpg[/img]

Another change is gift receiving ceremony. Be it stickers, skins or plane parts, after playing well, receiving gifts deserves a short ceremony, check it out.

Other fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*]new stickers added: collect them as you play
[*]arcade controls are now default for beginners. It's easy to switch to expert controls in-game in pause menu.
[*]championship mode moves faster through menus, no need to show other players before each race.
[*]after race, menus were sometimes mistakenly showing older presents.
[*]options menu has now FPS limit option to help the game run smoother across different computers.
[/list]

notes.title: Halloween Update: Plane Customizations
notes.notes:
This update brings plane customizations. As you progress, you will collect plane parts, skins and stickers (or decals if you prefer). Some parts are cosmetic and some performance based. 

Also for the next 10 days in the spirit of Halloween there are some Halloween themed items in the game that will be given to players (when racing) during that time. After10 days, these items will not be available anymore but if you collect them now you get to keep them. 

[img]http://www.altitude0.com/shared/images/a0_news_planecustomization.jpg[/img]

On top of that, a bunch of bug fixes based on user reports are included in this update: 
[list]
[*]Bug fixed: replays saved in user created tracks crashed the game. 
[*]Intro video music volume was way too loud - fixed.
[*]A new Altitude0 forum set up for easier bug reporting and sharing your ideas - http://forum.altitude0.com
[/list]

notes.title: Altitude0 Update: Build & Play (10-10-14)
notes.notes:
Hi guys, a new update is out!

This update brings [b]Track Editor[/b].
Build your own tracks and share them with other players. 

As an example we included [b]Avatar inspired[/b] floating rocks track. It's probably a bit silly concept, but should be fun to race on.
And maybe you want to build your own tracks, please join!

[img]http://www.altitude0.com/shared/images/avatarCow.jpg[/img]


Below is a list of all other major features and fixes included in this update:
[list]
[*][b]Full mouse support[/b]. Flying with mouse is now possible in arcade mode. Mouse sensitivity is adjustable.
[*]Launcher in Steam version was removed. Game now has Full Controller support, ready for Big Screen and living room play.
[*]Graphics and controller settings can now be adjusted from the [b]in-game Options menu[/b].
[*]Arcade mode physics were further tuned and simplified to reduce the learning curve.
[*]More Steam achievements, currently there are 25 of them.
[*]Change your pilot slogan in the garage.
[*][b]Benchmark tool[/b] was fixed and moved to the Options menu.
[/list]
Have fun!
